Subject: OrbitAI discovery recap — fit + next step?

Hi Emma —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call so we’re aligned: 

- Primary use case: semantic search + contextual summarization for customer support transcripts (reduce handle time, improve deflection).
- Scale: ~400k new transcripts/month, peak concurrent query latency target ~150–200ms.
- Data & security: customer PII in transcripts; preference for VPC/private deployment or strong KMS controls.
- Success metrics: 20% reduction in handle time or 15% improvement in first-contact resolution within a 3-month pilot.
- Timeline: goal to decide on pilot approach by end of Q3, pilot in Q4.

Attached is a short one-pager recap and a proposed outline for a lightweight pilot (discovery-recap-orbitai.pdf).

Next steps I suggested on the call:
- You confirm top priority (latency vs. cost vs. strict on-prem requirement).
- If fit: I’ll send a 1-page pilot statement of work and a few slot options for a 15-minute alignment call.

Could you please let me know which priority is most important for your team right now, and whether the proposed Q4 pilot window still looks good? If helpful I can loop in our Solutions lead (Soojin) to sketch a technical runbook.

Thanks — looking forward to your thoughts.

—
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Ben — quick internal note: if you don’t hear back after this bump, two practical moves that often help:

1) Offer a single low-friction option: “15 min this Thursday at 11:00 AM PT — I’ll share a pilot one-pager and a cost range.”
2) Add a clear yes/no fit ask: “Is this a fit for OrbitAI?” — that reduces back-and-forth.

Suggested sentence you can paste into a follow-up to Emma (concise):

"If you could reply with a quick yes/no on fit that would help — and if yes, does 15 minutes on Thursday 11:00 AM PT work to review a pilot outline and ballpark costs?"

I can jump on the call to handle any technical questions and speed approval.

Following Marissa’s suggestion — very quick ask: is Redwood a fit for OrbitAI based on the notes below? A one-word reply ("Yes" or "No") is totally fine and very helpful.

If yes, would 15 minutes this Thursday 11:00 AM PT work to review a short pilot outline and ballpark pricing? I’ve attached a one-page pilot outline (pilot-outline.odt) and included a HubSpot link to the deal below for your reference.

If it’s not a fit, could you share the top reason so we can improve our recommendations? Examples we often hear: on-prem-only requirement, latency under 100ms, or internal compliance timeline that pushes pilot beyond Q4.

Thanks for the quick help either way — I’ll keep this short and respectful of your time.
